style_lock.standard: Commercial US children's coloring and activity book, black-and-white interior line art.
style_lock.line_weight: Thick clean outlines, 4-8px equivalent at print, large colorable regions, no tiny noodle lines, no gray wash.
style_lock.faces: Round child proportions: large eyes, small noses, simple mouths, ears visible, five fingers. No adult fashion-model faces.
style_lock.bodies: Ages 6-8 proportions, heads about 1/5 of height, simple fall clothing with a consistent palette logic even in B/W (stripe, solid, overalls, hoodie).
style_lock.medium: Ink on paper coloring-book plate. Not 3D, not photoreal, not anime, not watercolor wash, not clip-art stickers.
style_lock.composition: One coherent integrated scene per page. Not a collage, sticker sheet, or pasted strip.
style_lock.no_text: Generate NO titles, verses, instructions, page numbers, signs, logos, captions, watermarks, letters, or numbers. Blank lanterns, blank collar tags, blank banners, blank book covers.

clothing_logic.mira: Simple crewneck sweater, round-toed shoes, chin-length dark bob with a small round hair clip on the right. Often a paper-bag lantern with no writing.
clothing_logic.eli: Striped long-sleeve shirt, sneakers, short curly hair.
clothing_logic.joy: Overalls over a t-shirt, small boots, two puffs with round hair ties that have no letters.
clothing_logic.caleb: Zip hoodie, sneakers, straight hair with bangs.
clothing_logic.pip: Medium scruffy mixed-breed dog, floppy ears, oval collar tag that is completely blank.

environment_language.architecture: Friendly wooden church, barn, porches, and booths with thick posts and simple shingles. Steeple cross stays intact. No ruined or scary buildings.
environment_language.fall: Oak leaves, pumpkins, apples, wheat, corn, acorns. Large colorable shapes, not leaf-confetti noise.
environment_language.light: Lantern glow and porch lamps as simple radiating lines, never lettered.
environment_language.depth: Foreground props, mid-ground cast, background building or trees. Every hero and search scene needs three depths.

icon_family.rule: One reusable icon set for legends, faith cards, and answer callouts. Same line weight as the cast. Code draws final numbers/labels on top.

cast.name: Mira
cast.look: Round cheerful face, chin-length dark bob with a small round hair clip on the right, medium-warm skin, simple crewneck sweater, round-toed shoes. Often holds a paper-bag lantern with a candle glow but no writing on the lantern.

cast.name: Eli
cast.look: Short curly hair, medium-deep skin, striped long-sleeve shirt, kind open expression, sneakers.

cast.name: Joy
cast.look: Two puffs with round hair ties (no letters on the ties), lighter skin, overalls over a t-shirt, small boots.

cast.name: Caleb
cast.look: Straight hair with bangs, light-medium skin, zip hoodie, sneakers, gentle posture.

cast.name: Pip
cast.look: Medium scruffy mixed-breed dog, floppy ears, oval collar tag that is completely blank, friendly face, sitting or walking beside the children.

consistency_rules: The same five characters appear across all 8 missions with unchanged face, hair, and clothing logic.
Each mission uses a distinct environment so pages do not look cloned.
Hero pages show 3-5 children plus optional Pip.
Search backgrounds never include the eight code-placed targets.
Mazes are part of the environment, not a grid on a blank plate.
Faith pages use illustrated choice cards, not form checkboxes as the visual identity.
